boundary: Offline development cache only; not a formal result or the deployed learner's image/feature memory

metrics.definition: Fractions; AIA is mean stage sample-weighted all-seen accuracy; forgetting averages old tasks only.

score_convention: FP32 analytic logits, CPU torch.topk; exact tie order may differ from CUDA topk

task_diagnostics.bias: flat prior, recovered from centered moments
task_diagnostics.history: exact sufficient statistics for the caller's immutable feature map
task_diagnostics.weighting: unit weight per historical fitting row; no class reweighting
